expectations.text: Response says to set base in vite.config.ts to /<repo-name>/ for GitHub Pages subdirectory routing.
expectations.evidence: Response shows: `base: '/<repo-name>/', // e.g. '/chai-chasers/'` in vite.config.ts and explains 'Without this, all asset paths break on Pages (assets load fine on localhost but 404 on the subdirectory URL)'.

expectations.text: Response provides the GitHub Pages URL pattern: https://<github-username>.github.io/<repo-name>/
expectations.evidence: Response shows: `https://<github-username>.github.io/<repo-name>/` as the Pages URL in the GitHub Settings → Pages step and in the README structure table.

expectations.text: Response states both URLs must be kept in README.md so judges browsing the GitHub repo can reach the live app in one click without going to Replit.
expectations.evidence: Response states: 'The skill is direct: keep both URLs in README.md. Judges who browse the GitHub repo must reach the live app in one click.' Shows a README table with both Replit and Pages URLs.

expectations.text: Response explains the GitHub Actions deploy workflow triggers on every push to main, and references the okhp3-vite-github-pages skill for the full runbook.
expectations.evidence: Response states: 'Trigger on every push to main' in the Actions workflow steps, and 'The skill refers you to the okhp3-vite-github-pages skill for the exact workflow YAML — read that skill for the complete runbook.'
